title: Authority-grant mapping (People's Court Partner API v2)
description: Output contract for the authority mapping the adapter derives from an ADAL/1 dispute package's consent layer. Mirrors the documented authority-grant surface (/api/v2/authorizations/authority-grants). The mapped object is a CANDIDATE derived from modeled consent data; a live authority grant additionally requires an authorization credential and the platform's confirmation binding (actorId/principalId + digest-bound statement).
